title: Unmount cleanup marks the overlay hidden before sending the hide IPC
reasoning: The unmount cleanup resets lastFrameRef.current to the hidden state before calling reportOverlaySize({ visible: false }). reportOverlaySize immediately returns when lastFrameRef.current.visible is already false, so a visible response overlay can be left visible in the main process after the hook unmounts.
recommendation: Call reportOverlaySize({ visible: false }) before resetting lastFrameRef.current, or add a dedicated hide path that always invokes SET_RESPONSEBOX_SIZE on unmount when the last recorded frame was visible.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for this feature, and the existing package scripts only show that Jest exists, not that this lifecycle path is covered.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a hook/unit test that sets the last frame to visible, unmounts the hook, and asserts IpcBridge.invoke(INVOKE_CHANNELS.SET_RESPONSEBOX_SIZE, { visible: false, width: 0, height: 0 }) is called.
